ability.name: Step 0 - Machine Context Check
ability.description: Determine platform, domain membership, current identity, token privileges, and AV/EDR status natively.

stages.command_template: $d='C:\Windows\Temp\bas'; if(!(Test-Path $d)){ni -ItemType Directory -Force $d|out-null}; $(try { $id = whoami; $cs = Get-WmiObject Win32_ComputerSystem; $dom = $cs.PartOfDomain; $dn = $cs.Domain; $os = (Get-WmiObject Win32_OperatingSystem).Caption; $hn = $env:COMPUTERNAME; $privs = @(); whoami /priv /fo csv | ConvertFrom-Csv | ForEach-Object { if ($_.PrivilegeName) { $privs += $_.PrivilegeName } }; $av = @(); try { $avProducts = Get-WmiObject -Namespace root\SecurityCenter2 -Class AntiVirusProduct -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if ($avProducts) { foreach ($prod in $avProducts) { $av += $prod.displayName } } } catch {}; $commonServices = @('Defender', 'CrowdStrike', 'CarbonBlack', 'SentinelOne', 'Cylance', 'Cortex', 'Sysmon'); foreach ($svc in $commonServices) { if (Get-Service -Name "*$svc*" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { $av += $svc } }; $av = $av | Sort-Object -Unique; $adapters = Get-NetIPAddress -AddressFamily IPv4 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.IPAddress -notlike '127.*' -and $_.PrefixLength -lt 32 } | ForEach-Object { "ADAPTER: $($_.InterfaceAlias)  IP: $($_.IPAddress)  CIDR_LEN: $($_.PrefixLength)" }; Write-Output "PLATFORM: windows"; Write-Output "HOSTNAME: $hn"; Write-Output "DOMAIN_JOINED: $dom"; Write-Output "DOMAIN: $dn"; Write-Output "OS: $os"; Write-Output "CURRENT_USER: $id"; Write-Output "TOKEN_PRIVILEGES: $($privs -join ',')"; Write-Output "AV_EDR: $($av -join ',')"; $adapters | ForEach-Object { Write-Output $_ } } catch { "ERROR: $_" }) | Tee-Object -FilePath $d\step0.txt

rationale: Queries local system information natively to establish initial operational parameters and check for AV/EDR profiles without dropping files.
